prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic, high-resolution image of a young man standing indoors in a futuristic, minimalist building with smooth white walls and large glass windows. The subject is positioned in the foreground, captured from the waist up with a wide aspect ratio. He wears a loose, oversized blue plaid jacket over a bright pink shirt, accessorized with a chunky silver chain necklace. His expression is relaxed and slightly open-mouthed, conveying a sense of nonchalance or surprise. He has shoulder-length, light brown hair and wears a black beanie with white text. His hands are placed behind his head, elbows out, in a casual, confident pose. The background is softly lit with cool, diffused natural light, creating a clean, airy atmosphere. Subtle reflections and blurred architectural elements add depth, while the overall color palette features cool blues and whites contrasted by the vivid pink of his shirt. The style is modern, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the subject, evoking a contemporary fashion editorial or music video aesthetic.
